scope: Every selected enterable structure and every ground/upper loot socket. 0.5m candidate grid with center headroom/support rays, real standing capsule authority/prediction movement on each edge, then continuous traversal of the complete route in both directions. Pickup uses production 2.7m 3D range with 0.1m arrival margin; parity<.001m, floor gap<.45m. This is a reachable route search, not human control acceptance or decorative mesh collision proof. Roof routes are separately validated.
